systems.tiers: Citizens report online; 80,902 reports since its creation in June 2023, by the police spokesman (59,115 missing vehicles, 21,431 against property, 289 missing persons, 67 against the person); citizens are told they may report at police stations or through the platform

note: No fact: the electronic report platform is a channel through which the public reports, a noted class; the statement says nothing of how a police station records a report it takes. The date of the spokesman's statement is not given beyond the article's proxy date of 2025-01-30.
